body:
`agents.rs::merge_from` appends the model a run used to every model's label, so a configured model shows what an older run used: `Local: Strata Swift · swift-iq2_xs` after the config's `model` became `swift-iq3_xxs`. The stamp exists for aliases, whose `model` is a family word.

- Stamp only an alias entry, one whose `model` is `opus`, `sonnet`, `haiku` or `fable`; a model with its own `model` (preset, discovered id, configured endpoint) shows that.
- `board.rs::models` serves each model's `model` string; `<solace-task>`'s `Agent` decodes it and the pick shows it under the label, so a config edit shows on the next poll (`board.rs::system` reads `config.toml` every request).
- `record_used` keeps recording what a run used: the run line still names it, and an alias's label follows it.
title: agents: a model's label names its own model
